```python
import itertools
import json
from collections import Counter

categories = {
    "opinion": "lovely terrible wonderful repulsive nice silly good ridiculous awful",
    "size": "huge small normal-size enormous massive midsize big tiny large little medium-size",
    "age": "old brand-new archaic ancient old-fashioned new",
    "shape": "triangular square rectangular circular spherical pyramidal",
    "material": "paper iron cloth steel leather glass cardboard plastic",
    "color": "gray black blue brown magenta teal cyan pink violet red green yellow white",
    "purpose": "exercise eating driving snorkeling smoking walking typing whittling hiking drinking",
    "origin": "egyptian indian mexican chinese ethiopian indonesian american german turkish nigerian bangladeshi",
}
word_category = {
    word: category
    for category, words in categories.items()
    for word in words.split()
}

givens = """
exercise egyptian shoe
old piano
eating banana
lovely huge bicycle
lovely candle
small apple
terrible normal-size necklace
wonderful gray driving bicycle
paper black shirt
snorkeling indian calculator
repulsive bag
smoking mexican vase
snorkeling ring
nice enormous pencil
triangular banana
walking mexican car key
silly massive candle
lovely normal-size knife
exercise jar
good screwdriver
ridiculous bed
midsize iron mexican jar
paper blue car
driving chinese sofa
brand-new calculator
square bed
brown canvas
ethiopian sunglasses
terrible guitar
small earring
indonesian dog
awful speaker
rectangular shoe
big vase
iron bowl
eating house
blue earring
black camera
huge cup
square car key
archaic circular speaker
ancient hat
indonesian lamp
exercise brush
brand-new triangular fire extinguisher
cloth banana
normal-size lamp
new rectangular cup
snorkeling american spoon
spherical saw
typing shoe
whittling book
circular bird
indonesian key
magenta bowl
german sofa
egyptian ruler
teal plate
cyan dog
snorkeling chinese jar
steel black pencil
paper banana
brand-new jar
tiny earring
repulsive large wallet
paper pink vase
wonderful candle
old-fashioned necklace
magenta house
paper violet clock
blue umbrella
leather pink bottle
square guitar
ethiopian car key
tiny umbrella
""".strip().splitlines()

options = {
    "A": "good large leather red hiking german brand-new key",
    "B": "circular glass pink hiking mexican little repulsive saw",
    "C": "triangular old-fashioned iron pink eating turkish midsize canvas",
    "D": "old cardboard black snorkeling nigerian large terrible fork",
    "E": "terrible midsize cloth green walking american old pyramidal box",
    "F": "awful tiny glass yellow smoking bangladeshi wrench",
    "G": "lovely little plastic red drinking american pyramidal bowl",
    "H": "old pyramidal leather violet whittling turkish chair",
    "I": "ancient rectangular steel violet eating mexican normal-size wonderful watch",
    "J": "medium-size plastic white walking bangladeshi old rectangular hat",
}

def adjective_categories(sentence):
    result = []
    for word in sentence.split():
        if word not in word_category:
            break
        result.append(word_category[word])
    return result

edges = set()
for sentence in givens:
    sequence = adjective_categories(sentence)
    edges.update(zip(sequence, sequence[1:]))

option_sequences = {
    letter: adjective_categories(sentence)
    for letter, sentence in options.items()
}

outcomes = Counter()
witnesses = {}
valid_orders = 0

for order in itertools.permutations(categories):
    rank = {category: index for index, category in enumerate(order)}
    if not all(rank[left] < rank[right] for left, right in edges):
        continue
    valid_orders += 1
    answer = "".join(
        letter
        for letter, sequence in option_sequences.items()
        if all(rank[a] < rank[b] for a, b in zip(sequence, sequence[1:]))
    ) or "K"
    outcomes[answer] += 1
    witnesses.setdefault(answer, order)

if len(outcomes) == 1:
    final_answer = next(iter(outcomes))
else:
    final_answer = "UNSUPPORTED"

evidence = {
    "consistent_category_orders": valid_orders,
    "answer_counts": dict(sorted(outcomes.items())),
}
if len(outcomes) > 1:
    examples = sorted(outcomes)[:2]
    evidence["conflicting_witnesses"] = {
        answer: witnesses[answer] for answer in examples
    }
    evidence["reason"] = (
        "The givens do not uniquely determine which options are correct."
    )

print(json.dumps({"final_answer": final_answer, "evidence": evidence},
                 separators=(",", ":")))
```
